Theme

stick noun

also staff, walking staff, club, cudgel, bludgeon

classical

baculum, baculī n.

noun, second declension · Declension on Wiktionary

stick or staff

Useful for a stick picked up on a walk. baculum is the walking staff.

Other words

  • bacillum, bacillī n. — small staff, wand

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Juv. 3.28 (Lewis & Short) · Declension on Wiktionary

    The diminutive of baculum. Our reader series uses it for the boy’s stick.

  • fūstis, fūstis m. — club or cudgel

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Traupman 193: bludgeon; Traupman 281; Traupman 293 · Declension on Wiktionary

Examples

  • Baculum cape.

    Pick up the stick.composed

See also rod, pole, twig, branch.
